definition_akan: Di yɛ sɛ obi de aduane kɔ n'anom na ɔwe.
definition_english: To eat means to take food into the mouth and consume it.
explanation_akan: Nnipa di aduane de nya ahoɔden ne aduanenoa mu nneɛma a nipadua hia.
examples_akan: Me di aduane.
Yɛdi nkɔmmɔ bere a yɛredidi.

definition_akan: Kɔ yɛ sɛ obi tu firi beaeɛ baako kɔ beaeɛ foforɔ.
definition_english: To go means to move from one place to another.
explanation_akan: Kɔ yɛ adeɛ a nnipa yɛ daa de kɔ sukuu, adwuma, fie anaa baabi foforɔ.
examples_akan: Me kɔ sukuu.
Ɔkɔ fie.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛkɔ baabi?

definition_akan: Nom yɛ sɛ obi de nsuo anaa nsã a wɔtumi nom kɔ ne anom.
definition_english: To drink means to take a liquid into the mouth and swallow it.
explanation_akan: Nnipa nom nsuo, nufusu ne anonneɛ ahodoɔ. Nsuo nom yɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia ma nipadua.
examples_akan: Me nom nsuo.
Mmofra no nom nufusu.

definition_akan: Aboa yɛ nkwa adeɛ a ɛnyɛ nnipa na ɛtumi di, home, nyin na ɛwo.
definition_english: An animal is a living organism that is not a human and can feed, breathe, grow, and reproduce.
explanation_akan: Mmoa yɛ abɔdeɛ a wɔwɔ akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so tena ase. Nnipa de mmoa di dwuma wɔ aduane, kuayɛ ne nneɛma foforɔ mu.
examples_akan: Ɔkraman yɛ aboa.
Mmoa hia aduane ne nsuo.

definition_akan: Nkitahodie yɛ ɔkwan a nnipa fa so de nsɛm anaa adwene kɔ obi foforɔ nkyɛn.
definition_english: Communication is the process of sharing information or ideas with another person or group.

examples_akan: Kasa yɛ nkitahodie kwan.
Telefon boa ma yɛkasa wɔ akyirikyiri.
examples_english: Speech is a form of communication.
Telephones help us communicate over distance.

definition_akan: Anigyeɛ yɛ nkateɛ a ɛma obi te nka sɛ n'ani agye na ne koma atɔ ne yam.
definition_english: Happiness is an emotional state in which a person feels pleased or joyful.
explanation_akan: Anigyeɛ betumi aba bere a obi nya adeɛ a ɔpɛ, di nkonim, nya abusuabɔ pa anaa osuahu a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ.
examples_akan: N'ani gyeeɛ paa.
Nkonimdie no maa no anigyeɛ.
question_patterns: Dɛn na ɛtumi ma obi ani gye?

definition_akan: Awerɛhoɔ yɛ nkateɛ a ɛma obi te yaw anaa anigyeɛ a ɛnni ne mu.
definition_english: Sadness is an emotional state involving sorrow or a lack of happiness.
explanation_akan: Awerɛhoɔ tumi ba bere a obi hwere obi, nnya nea ɔhwɛ kwan, anaa ɔfa osuahu a ɛyɛ den mu.
examples_akan: Asɛm no maa no awerɛhoɔ.
Ɔwɔ awerɛhoɔ wɔ ne koma mu.
examples_english: He has sadness in his heart.
question_patterns: Dɛn na ɛtumi de awerɛhoɔ ba?

definition_akan: Agya yɛ ɔbarima a ɔwoo obi anaa ɔyɛ obi papa wɔ abusua mu.
definition_english: A father is a man who fathers a person or serves as a male parent in a family.
explanation_akan: Agya yɛ abusua mu ɔwofoɔ a ɔtumi boa ma mmofra nya akwankyerɛ, hwɛ wɔn na ɔma wɔn mmoa.
examples_akan: Me agya reyɛ adwuma.
Agya ne ne mma kasa.
examples_english: The father talks with his children.

definition_akan: Ɛna yɛ ɔbea a ɔwoo obi.
definition_english: A mother is a woman who gives birth to a person.
explanation_akan: Ɛna yɛ abusua mu nipa a ɔtaa hwɛ ne mma, ma wɔn akwankyerɛ na ɔboa wɔn wɔ asetena mu.
examples_akan: Me ɛna wɔ fie.
Ɛna hwɛ ne mma.
examples_english: A mother takes care of her children.

definition_akan: Aduane yɛ nneɛma a nnipa di de nya ahoɔden ne aduanenoa mu mfasoɔ.
definition_english: Food consists of substances people eat to obtain energy and nutrients.
explanation_akan: Aduane ho hia ma nipadua nyin, ahoɔden ne apɔmuden. Aduane ahodoɔ ma nipadua nya nneɛma a ɛhia.
examples_akan: Me pɛ aduane.
Aduane pa boa nipadua.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na aduane ho hia?

definition_akan: Asase yɛ ɔkwan anaa beaeɛ a nnipa, mmoa ne afifideɛ te anaa nyin so.
definition_english: Land is the solid ground or area on which people, animals, and plants live or grow.
explanation_akan: Asase ho hia ma kuayɛ, adan sie, nnipa asetena ne nneɛma pii a yɛyɛ wɔ asetena mu.
examples_akan: Yɛdua afifideɛ wɔ asase mu.
Nnipa te asase so.
examples_english: We plant crops in the soil.

definition_akan: Wia yɛ ɔsoro fã a yɛhu no fi asase so.
definition_english: The sky is the region above the earth that we see from the ground.
explanation_akan: Wia yɛ beaeɛ a yɛhu owia, ɔsram ne nsoromma wɔ bere ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Owia wɔ wia mu.
Nsoromma pue wɔ wia mu anadwo.
examples_english: The sun is in the sky.
Stars appear in the sky at night.
question_patterns: Dɛn na yɛhu wɔ wia mu?

definition_akan: Apɔmuden yɛ tebea a obi nipadua ne n'adwene yɛ adwuma yie.
definition_english: Health is a state in which a person's body and mind function well.
explanation_akan: Apɔmuden hwehwɛ sɛ obi hwɛ ne nipadua, di aduane pa, nya ahomegyeɛ na ɔkwati nneɛma a ɛtumi ma no yareɛ.
examples_akan: Apɔmuden ho hia.
Aduane pa boa apɔmuden.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na apɔmuden ho hia?

definition_akan: Ɔyareɛ yɛ tebea a ɛma nipadua anaa adwene ntumi nyɛ adwuma sɛnea ɛsɛ.
definition_english: A disease is a condition that affects the normal functioning of the body or mind.
explanation_akan: Ɔyareɛ bi tumi firi mmoawa, nkwa mu tebea, awosu anaa nneɛma foforɔ mu. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ yareɛ no mu na wɔnya ayaresa a ɛfata.
examples_akan: Ɔyareɛ no maa no yɛɛ mmerɛ.
Ɔkɔɔ ayaresabea sɛ wɔnhwɛ ne yareɛ.
examples_english: He went to the hospital to have his illness examined.
question_patterns: Dɛn na ɛtumi de ɔyareɛ ba?

definition_akan: Nimdeɛ yɛ nsɛm, nokware, nteaseɛ ne nim a obi nya fa adeɛ anaa asɛm bi ho.
definition_english: Knowledge is information, facts, understanding, and awareness acquired about a subject or situation.
explanation_akan: Nimdeɛ betumi aba denam adesua, osuahunu, nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a yɛtie ne nneɛma a yɛhu wɔ asetena mu.
examples_akan: Adesua boa ma yenya nimdeɛ.
Nhwehwɛmu betumi ama yɛanya nimdeɛ foforɔ.
examples_english: Research can give us new knowledge.

definition_akan: Adwene yɛ nsusuiɛ anaa nteaseɛ a ɛba obi tirim.
definition_english: Thought is an idea, consideration, or mental process that occurs in a person's mind.
explanation_akan: Nnipa de adwene yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, susu ɔhaw ho na wɔsi gyinaeɛ.
examples_akan: Ɔde ne adwene sii ɔhaw no so.
Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsusu ansa na yɛasi gyinaeɛ.
examples_english: He focused his thought on the problem.
We should think before making a decision.
